content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes roadway, vegetation and agricultural equipment for municipalities and farms, not pool and spa equipment for pool owners and builders."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes ceiling and wall building products for commercial construction, a different product and customer set from pool equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Makes roofing membranes, insulation and industrial brake components, with no overlap with pool and spa equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Mines and sells salt and fertilizer, a raw-materials business unrelated to pool pumps, filters, heaters and controls."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Makes construction coatings, HVAC components and industrial valves for contractors and plants, not pool and spa equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes residential and commercial HVAC and refrigeration equipment, a different product line from pool and spa equipment."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Builds recreational performance boats sold to watersports buyers, not pool and spa equipment sold to pool professionals."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for building markets, unrelated to pool and spa equipment."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Distributes pool supplies to the same pool trade customers but earns margin as a distributor, not by manufacturing equipment."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes lawn mowers, snow blowers and irrigation equipment for landscapers and homeowners, not pool and spa equipment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Builds recreational vehicles and buses sold through RV dealers, unrelated to pool and spa equipment."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes commercial plumbing fixtures, water coolers and filtration for non-residential buildings, not pool and spa equipment."}]}
